node.title: XR nongeneric-explanation Plotkin width
node.statement: At one mismatch instance with A=K+h and H=h+1, canonically truncated A-supports of distinct joint codeword-pair explanations form an injective constant-weight code with pairwise intersection at most K-1=A-H and distance at least 2H. Hence there are at most floor(4H/(4H-N)) explanations when N<4H, at most 2N at equality, and polynomially many whenever N-4H<=C log_2 n. Once descent enters N<=4H, its live subtree has at most 1+104H instances and 420H^2 tangent charges. More generally, if H>=2C log_2 n, the whole fixed-logarithmic subtree has at most 1+200n^(C+1) instances and 201n^(C+2) tangent charges. Generic chart slopes and pre-terminal slope fibers remain open.
